_what: B1 §6.1 guarantee cohort for the live load harness (W4), with every review change: one member per fault, all expected ENGAGED, dying behind the go barrier while the daemon is live (t0 = death). n = 10, not the incident's 9: target-limited (F20), slow-boot (F6) and c_rpc_fail_twice (W8's power group) were added and two clean members folded away. late-death is the design's true-busy member relabelled (C4): WORKING through a 300 s turn, limited at its end. Boots draw from gap-4's 30-40/core distribution (F6); two busy_extra panes hold the restore budget (F5). The placer block makes the heavy lead placeable by making the clamp bind (C1): KMAX 8 clamps weight 19 to 7. Per-member scope keeps known open defects from failing the pair: the restart member's H3/H6 belong to A6 (C9) and the RPC-failure member's H2/H3 to W8 until their owners flip them in load-expect.json or here.
